tools.name: search_links
tools.description: Search aflink.us for Air Force and DoD websites by name, acronym, URL, category or purpose (for example "mypay", "travel voucher", "leave"). Every word must match. Returns each link's title, URL and category, best matches (title matches) first. Links in the UNOFFICIAL category are third-party sites,

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_links" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
